title: Tencent WorkBuddy Enterprise Edition: Office Suite Upgrade with Multi-Device Account and Asset Integration, Further Enhancing Corporate Productivity

content_html:
On September 23, Tencent WorkBuddy Enterprise Edition released the latest progress of its office suite upgrade. Tencent Docs, Tencent LeXiang, Tencent Weiyun, Security and Efficiency Operations Platform, and Tencent AI Design Intelligent Agent Ardot were initially integrated. After the upgrade, the price of Tencent WorkBuddy Enterprise Edition remains unchanged, and capabilities such as documents, knowledge bases, cloud storage, design, and security and efficiency are all incorporated into a unified enterprise office system. Some products offer higher version benefits, which can be purchased on demand in the enterprise control panel.

Tencent WorkBuddy plays the role of an Agent Harness within the suite, providing power to internal products with unified planning, skills, and context capabilities. For enterprises, this achieves "three one": one subscription, one Agent base, and one management console — no longer needing to pay separately for AI features of individual products. Administrators can manage all product credit usage from one entry point, and enable AI across different ends to read and write the same office memory and data, optimizing Agent delivery and output quality, further upgrading the AI-native office experience and enhancing enterprise productivity.

One Subscription, One Management Console, AI-Native Office Experience Upgraded

After the office suite upgrade of Tencent WorkBuddy Enterprise Edition, Tencent Docs, Tencent LeXiang, Tencent Weiyun, Security and Efficiency Operations Platform, and Tencent AI Design Intelligent Agent Ardot are no longer just standalone apps but can be directly called within WorkBuddy. With the capability upgrade, after purchasing the Tencent WorkBuddy Enterprise Edition, enterprises can gain access to membership rights of the above five products at no additional cost. For example, Ardot provides design seats, allowing initial design drafts generated in WorkBuddy's "Design Creative Mode" to be directly refined, collaborated on, and delivered in Ardot.

More importantly than the benefit upgrades, the creation of office content, asset accumulation, and capability reuse will be unified within WorkBuddy, forming an integrated intelligent agent matrix centered around enterprise knowledge flow and content production.

Take Tencent Docs as an example. After the upgrade, meeting minutes, proposals, and standards scattered within it are converted into contexts that agents can directly read, making the document a long-term corporate memory. When starting work, team members don't need to manually compile materials; they can simply hand over the document to WorkBuddy, which carries both the file and background information forward. Humans and AI co-write the same document, with instructions directly written into the original text, and changes automatically merged, with every change traceable to who made it. Each modification and execution is accumulated into corporate knowledge, allowing the next task to start with previous conclusions, continuously improving delivery quality. According to a large agricultural enterprise's production management practice, after collaborating with WorkBuddy and Tencent Docs, eight major production processes' full data can be uniformly collected, intelligently parsed, and daily reports automatically generated, with abnormal AI intelligent identification. The process previously requiring three levels of manual copying has been transformed into automated data flow, enabling managers to view the entire factory's operations instantly instead of manually compiling and summarizing.

Tencent LeXiang serves as the trusted knowledge hub within the suite, organizing scattered system documents, business cases, and experience records into trusted, usable, and evolving knowledge assets. It manages repetitive, outdated knowledge or conflicting information, reducing the risk of employees and agents misusing knowledge. Valuable outcomes confirmed by the company can be returned to LeXiang and included in the enterprise knowledge management process for future team use, ensuring continuous support for business delivery. According to self-calculations by a ToB solution delivery service provider, after using WorkBuddy and Tencent LeXiang together, approximately 2.3 hours per person per day were saved in relevant delivery scenarios.

The Tencent AI Design Intelligent Agent Ardot is the canvas for professional design within this system. WorkBuddy creates the initial draft, while Ardot performs professional refinement, pushing design to deliverable, storable, and reusable standards. Requirements, component libraries, and R&D deliveries are aligned in Ardot, transforming design standards from "individual skills" into "organizational capabilities" — each team's output starts with brand compliance from the beginning.

The capacity of Tencent Weiyun has been increased from 5GB per person to 50GB per person, tenfold expansion, eliminating the need for enterprises to purchase additional storage space. Smart management and search of files continue to use existing enterprise permission settings, keeping data always within the enterprise's pool. The Security and Efficiency Operations Platform acts as the dashboard of this system, helping enterprise managers identify security risks better, keeping people, time, interaction content, data objects, and risky behaviors on the same chain, ensuring risks are controllable, manageable, and traceable.

AI Efficiency Flywheel: From Individual Efficiency to Organizational Productivity Upgrade

After account and context integration, changes will continue to occur. Daily workflows and judgments run through become Skills and experts, turning personal experience into directly reusable team capabilities; the next round of tasks does not have to start from scratch but can begin with previous conclusions.

Thus, the enterprise AI flywheel begins to rotate: the more calls made, the richer the context in the enterprise space; the richer the context, the closer the agent's delivery to the enterprise's own standards; the more accurate the delivery, the more willing members are to assign more work to it. Individual daily efficiency improvements ultimately accumulate into organizational smart assets and drive productivity upgrades.

For example, in the consumer goods industry, Shanghai Jiahe, a leading daily chemical company, has widely implemented the WorkBuddy Enterprise Edition across nine departments, achieving an average efficiency improvement of over four times. After employees solidified mature processes into Skills, one department's proven capabilities could be directly reused by other departments. Jiahe stated that WorkBuddy has evolved from an individual efficiency tool into a "digital employee" embedded in business processes.

More industries have also adopted WorkBuddy, aiding office efficiency and productivity upgrades. In the government sector,湾擎·WorkBuddy was officially launched in August, offering AI intelligent office capabilities to Guangdong government systems, with the Guangdong Provincial Medical Insurance Bureau and other first-level units conducting dozens of scene connections and pilot projects. In education, more than 6,000 primary and secondary school teachers in Laizhou City, Shandong Province, have been equipped with AI teaching assistants, with WorkBuddy jointly launching 33 educational experts and 15 teaching Skills on the Penguin Teacher Assistant, covering scenarios such as lesson preparation and research. In media, WorkBuddy has "joined" the CCTV reporting team, participating in the full coverage of the Davos Forum and the WAIC World Artificial Intelligence Conference by CCTV.

Since its launch in early March 2026, WorkBuddy has completed over 50 versions of iterations, with the enterprise edition being rapidly deployed in over 50 industries including government, education, retail, finance, media, and transportation, driving enterprise productivity improvements. Tencent WorkBuddy stated that more products and applications will be added to the office suite in the future, continuously assisting enterprises in improving office efficiency and productivity.
